description:
Rellena marcadores {{variable}} de una plantilla con valores, informando faltantes y no usados; sin ejecutar código. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: estimar heurísticamente cuántos tokens de LLM usa un texto, con un rango de ±25 % (token-estimate). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Fills {{variable}} placeholders (dotted paths allowed, optional {{name|default}}) from a values object, reporting missing and unused variables; strict mode fails on missing values. No code execution. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). inputSchema.description: EN: Fills {{variable}} placeholders (dotted paths allowed, optional {{name|default}}) from a values object, reporting missing and unused variables; strict mode fails on missing values. No code execution. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: heuristically estimating how many LLM tokens a text uses (token-estimate). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

escape.description: Escape inserted values (optional; one of: none, html, json; default "none").

strict.description: Fail when a variable is missing and has no default (boolean; optional; default false).
